parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of IdP groups to return. Defaults to 50. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Send the same filters that the previous request used.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded filters that choose which IdP groups are returned. The supported fields are provider_instance, provider, and name. The only supported operator is EQUALS. Multiple values OR within a filter. Multiple filters AND together. The name field may appear in only one filter. A value that matches no IdP group returns no IdP groups rather than an error.

schema.description: Filters on IdP group fields, combined with AND.

items.description: One filter on an IdP group field.

field.description:
The IdP group field to filter on.
- provider_instance: matches groups from the datasource instance, such as
  "okta", ignoring case.

- provider: matches groups from the identity provider, such as "okta", ignoring
  case.

- name: matches groups whose display_name contains the value, ignoring case and
  surrounding whitespace. Each value is at most 256 characters.

values.description: The values to match. An IdP group matches when any value matches.

items.description: A value to match. Empty values, and blank name values, are rejected.

operator.description: The only supported operator is EQUALS. Defaults to EQUALS.

items.title: PlatformIdpGroupFilter
